issue.title: Procs pane hints line overflows its width: 'Esc: close' is already clipped at 120 columns, and the conditional monitor token drops three more keys
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY: closed phase bead sase-o9.5 (2026-08-17); re-measured by the sase-o9 land agent on master 26fefdab7.

DEFECT: `ProcsPane._hints()` (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/procs_pane.py) builds one fixed-width line and renders it into the `#procs-hints` `Static`. Nothing truncates, abbreviates, or wraps it, so the tail is silently cut off and the user loses real keybindings with no ellipsis or any other signal that more exists.

MEASURED (character counts of the rendered string, and the committed PNG goldens):
  - Without the monitor token: 114 chars. At a 120-column terminal the pane affords ~108 columns, so `Esc: close` is already cut to `Esc:`. Visible in tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/config_center_procs_tab_120x40.png.
  - With sase-o9.4's conditional `⏎: agent` token (+10 chars = 124): the line now cuts at `Tab:`, losing `tab  Esc: close`. Visible in config_center_procs_tab_monitors_120x40.png.
  - At 90 columns with the token, the cut lands right after `': jump`, losing `ctrl+d/u, g/G: scroll  Tab: tab  Esc: close`. Visible in config_center_procs_tab_monitors_90x40.png.

SO: the overflow is PRE-EXISTING (the 120-column clip of `close` predates sase-o9), and sase-o9's conditional monitor token widens the loss by 10 columns whenever a monitor row with a resolvable agent is selected. Both belong to the same fix; neither is worth a separate bead.

SCOPE: give the Procs hints line a width-aware treatment. Candidate approaches for the worker to choose between: render it as a Rich `Text` with `overflow='ellipsis'` so truncation is at least honest; drop lower-value tokens as width shrinks (the pane already knows its own width); or shorten the fixed tokens (`Tab: tab` and `Esc: close` are the least informative characters on the line). Check whether other panes with hints lines share the defect before inventing a Procs-only mechanism.

VERIFICATION: rebaseline the three Procs PNG goldens above and confirm at both 120 and 90 columns that either every token is visible or the truncation is explicit.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-o9 — the epic whose sase-o9.4 phase added the conditional '⏎: agent' token measured above, and whose sase-o9.5 phase proposed this follow-up after capturing it in config_center_procs_tab_monitors_90x40.png. Its three Procs PNG goldens are the ones a fix here has to rebaseline.
